MAP Weapons are extremely powerful and cannot be countered.
In this stage, the enemy will use MAP Weapons when 2 or more
allied units are within range, so plan your route carefully.

There are enemies with extremely high ATK and the Guaranteed
Chance Step (force-activate Chance Step 1 time) ability.
Exploit the gaps in the enemy's weapon range to avoid being hit.

Multiple enemies with the Support Attack ability appear.
Use Sway (increase own EVA by 100%) to reduce the number of
Support Attacks that the enemy can land.

MAP Weapons are extremely powerful and cannot be countered.
In this stage, the enemy will use MAP Weapons when 2 or more
allied units are within range, so plan your route carefully.

Multiple enemies with high ATK and the Guaranteed Chance Step
(force-activate Chance Step 1 time) ability are deployed in this
stage. Leverage MAP Weapons to devastate the enemy on turn 1.

Enemies with red effects have powerful abilities.
Prioritize the enemy with "Increased DEF (All)" to defeat
the rest efficiently.

In this stage, enemy reinforcements appear when you defeat
5 units and 12 units, respectively.
Keep track of how many you have defeated.

The G-3 Gundam is a powerful unit with extremely high ATK
and an ability that grants Chance Steps.
Prioritize defeating it.

Destroying 5 enemy units spawns many reinforcements with
Support Attacks. Spawn the reinforcements on your turn and
target the Support Attack units to reduce incoming damage.

In this stage, the reinforcements that appear after defeating
12 enemy units are positioned at a long range.
Leverage MAP Weapons to defeat them efficiently.

In this stage, the reinforcements that appear after defeating
12 enemy units are positioned at a long range.
Leverage MAP Weapons to defeat them efficiently.

You will lose if Kamille Bidan, Emma Sheen, or Quattro Bajeena
is defeated. Add characters (units) with Support Defense to your
formation, use Chance Steps, and protect the guest forces.

Guest forces can use your forces' Support Attacks/Defenses.
Defeat enemies by using Support Attacks and trigger Chance Steps
to move to positions where you can protect the guest forces.

The enemy forces' main squad is positioned in the upper left,
center, and lower right. Try to move your forces' units so that
their combat power is distributed evenly.

The Ptolemaios 2 has the Increased DEF (All) ability. Prioritize
destroying it while letting nearby units exhaust their Support
Defense uses.

After clearing mission objectives, Seraphim Gundam, which lowers
your squad's MOV, and 00 Raiser Final Battle Type will appear.
Position your units near its spawn point to destroy it quickly.

When the enemy 00 Raiser Final Battle Type's HP falls below 50%,
Cherudim Gundam and Arios Gundam will appear as reinforcements.
Note they will revive once with 50% HP after being defeated.

The reinforcements' Cherudim Gundam executes Support Attack from
a long range. However, the attack will not reach at certain
ranges, so be sure to avoid Counters and destroy it.

Be careful of the Arios Gundam, as it attacks repeatedly with
Guaranteed Chance Step. Use durability-type units to protect
your forces and try to destroy it with Counters.

If Gundam Aerial (Rebuild) survives, 6 Gundnode [MA]
units will appear as reinforcements every turn. They have
relatively low HP, so try to wipe them out every turn.

Gundam Calibarn has a long range and a strong Support Attack, so
be sure to destroy it early. Place your forces between enemies
with Support Defense to attack without allowing Support Defense.

A large number of enemy units are deployed in this stage,
and as you clear mission objectives, even more will appear.
Leverage MAP Weapons to defeat the enemy efficiently.

The Alpha Azierus possess the 
"HP Restoration (All Units)" ability.
Prioritize defeating them.

At the beginning of turns 2 and 3, Jagd Dogas appear
as enemy reinforcements. Since two of them possess the
"Increased DEF (All Units)" ability, prioritize defeating them.

The enemy Nightingale will use its MAP Weapon when 1 or more
allied units are within range, so plan your route carefully.

Without destroying all Alpha Azierus, isolating them 4 tiles or
more from the Nightingale or placing an allied unit in between
prevents Support Defend, allowing to attack the Nightingale.

In this stage, the high-ATK Destiny Gundam appears within the
third force. It attacks nearby units, friends or foes.
Take position carefully to let it attack enemy forces.

The Destiny Gundam deals approximately 500,000 damage to the
Dom Trooper. Use MAP Weapons on the enemy forces and
reduce the Dom Trooper's HP to around 500,000.

For this stage, reaching the target area satisfies the victory
condition. You can do this by clearing out enemies in the area,
or by using mobility-type MAP Weapons to quickly reach the area.

In this stage, reinforcements appear when you defeat certain
units. Pay attention to the order in which
you defeat them to reach the target area efficiently.

In this stage, reinforcements appear when you defeat certain
units. Pay attention to the order in which
you defeat them to reach the target area efficiently.

Prioritize defeating Pale Rider (Ground Heavy Equipment Type) 
and Efreet Customs. Each of them provides a 300% DEF increase
to Yuu Kajima and Nimbus Schterzen, who have Support Defense.

Some enemies have an ability that restores half of their HP when
it falls below 50%. Use skills or Support Attacks while their
remaining HP is above 50% to take them down right away.

Banagher Links and Riddhe Marcenas have Support Defense and
appear as enemy reinforcements at the start of the turn 1 enemy
phase. Defeat as many enemies as possible before they appear.
